_comment: Lane rule table of the lane-level task (Milestone 5). Used ONLY to prefill the actions and accepted rule IDs in the lane mode of the labeling tool; it never checks or corrects model answers, and every prefilled value can be changed. boundary: rows are tried in order and the first whose 'when' matches the side's attributes gives change_left or change_right (an empty string means the tool does not guess). markings: the actions a marking token in my lane decides. Movements: the arrows in the lane allow the movements they show and prohibit the others; a no_turn marking prohibits its movement; with no arrow in my lane go_straight is allowed (a project convention, contested: nothing restricts carrying on along my lane) and the turns and U-turn are not_applicable unless a no_turn marking decides them. enter_waiting_area is not_applicable unless a token allows it. With partial or insufficient evidence every allowed or prohibited value becomes not_determined. 'contested' marks cells whose value comes from a project convention rather than from a passage's words; they are scored separately. The single-marking table (action_rules.json) is not changed, so the saved runs keep their scores.
